grant.name: The relic of {target}
grant.lore: Lost a hundred years, found by a friend of {settlement}

title: The lost relic
What was taken from the chapel
summary: A relic of the chapel of {settlement} was carried to {target} in a bad year and never came back. The priest asks a trusted friend to fetch it.
offer: A hundred years ago, in the plague, the relic was carried to {target} and left there with the dead. Bring it home. I would not ask anyone I did not trust.
progress: The relic is still far away.
complete: Home at last. You will be remembered in our prayers as long as the chapel stands.
